file_spec.value: At application, a digital photograph is taken along with fingerprints of two fingers and a digitized handwritten signature (electronic/biometric passport); fingerprints are not taken from applicants under 12.

headwear_policy.value: A citizen who, according to national affiliation, religion, or custom, wears a cap or headscarf as an integral part of their dress may be photographed wearing it; however, the part of the face needed for identification must not be covered by the cap or headscarf when the photo is taken.

headwear.en: A citizen who, according to national affiliation, religion, or custom, wears a cap or headscarf as an integral part of their dress may be photographed wearing it; however, the part of the face needed for identification must not be covered by the cap or headscarf when the photo is taken.
headwear.ko: 민족적 소속, 종교, 또는 관습에 따라 모자나 스카프를 복장의 필수 요소로 착용하는 국민은 이를 착용한 채로 촬영할 수 있음; 다만 촬영 시 신원 확인에 필요한 얼굴 부위가 모자나 스카프에 가려져서는 안 됨.
headwear.ja: 民族的所属、宗教、または慣習により帽子やスカーフを服装の一部として着用する国民は、それを着用したまま撮影することができる。ただし撮影時、本人確認に必要な顔の部分が帽子やスカーフで隠れてはならない。

cross_verification.note_en: Source is Montenegro's Ministry of Interior (Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova) official procedure document, served from the gov.me subdomain wapi.gov.me. This document (about passport issuance procedure for Montenegrin citizens) does not state a numeric photo size, background color, or head-height figure. A separate, directly-verified Montenegrin regulation — the 'Pravilnik o vizama i viznim obrascima' (Regulation on Visas and Visa Forms) — DOES specify 35×45mm / 70-80% head height / white glossy paper, but that regulation applies explicitly to foreign nationals ('stranac') applying for a VISA, not to citizens' passports; see me-visa.json for that data. The passport-procedure document's headwear-exemption wording is nearly identical to the visa regulation's wording, suggesting Montenegro likely applies a unified national photo standard across document types, but this was not directly confirmed for passports specifically, so size/background/head_height are left unverified here rather than copied over from the visa regulation.
